strategies.title: Minimal pin upgrade only
strategies.rationale: Upgrade the Pydantic dependency pin to >=2,<3 without changing any source code. This verifies whether the existing v1 APIs (BaseModel, Field, validator, root_validator, parse_obj, parse_raw, dict) happen to work under v2 or surface breakage for later strategies.
ordered_steps: Update pyproject.toml dependency from pydantic>=1.10,<2 to pydantic>=2,<3
Run the test suite to observe failures

strategies.title: Compatibility shim via pydantic.v1 imports
strategies.rationale: Keep the application code on Pydantic v1 APIs by importing from pydantic.v1, while the project dependency is upgraded to v2. This isolates the app from v2 breaking changes with minimal code edits.
ordered_steps: Change imports in src/sample_app/models.py from 'from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, root_validator, validator' to 'from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel, Field, root_validator, validator'
Run the test suite to confirm v1 behavior is preserved

strategies.title: Full refactor to Pydantic v2 native APIs
strategies.rationale: Migrate the codebase to native Pydantic v2 constructs: replace v1 BaseModel/Field/validators with v2 equivalents, replace parse_obj with model_validate, parse_raw with model_validate_json, dict with model_dump, and Config class with model_config dict.
ordered_steps: Rewrite src/sample_app/models.py using pydantic.BaseModel, pydantic.Field, @field_validator, @model_validator, model_config dict, and v2 serialization methods
Rewrite src/sample_app/api.py to use model_validate, model_validate_json, and model_dump instead of parse_obj, parse_raw, and dict
Run the test suite to verify functional parity

citations.evidence: Title: Migration Guide - Pydantic Validation important changes to help you migrate your code from Pydantic V1 to Pydantic V2. by importing through `pydantic.v1`. For example, you can use the `BaseModel` class from Pydantic V1 instead of the. Pydantic V2 `pydantic.BaseModel` class:. `from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel`. `from pydantic.v1.fields import ModelField`. from pydantic.v1.fields import ModelField. The following sections provide details on the most important changes in Pydantic V2. from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel as V1BaseModel. from pydantic.v1 import BaseModel as V1BaseModel. The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called `Config`. In Pydantic V1, functions wrapped by `@validator` could receive keyword arguments with metadata about what was. Some of these arguments have been removed from `@field_validator` in Pydantic V2:. However, in Pydantic V2, when a `TypeError` is raised in a validator, it is no longer converted into a. from pydantic import BaseModel, field_validator. Pydantic V2 includes some changes to type coercion. See the Conversion table for details on Pydantic V2 type coercion defaults. In Pydantic V2, the `@validate_arguments` decorator has been renamed to `@validate_call`. In Pydantic V1 we made great efforts to preserve the types of all field inputs for generic collections when they were. citations.evidence: `BaseSettings` `pydantic-settings` Also, the `parse_env_var` classmethod has been removed.
